name_zh: 帕尔梅/瑞典/社民/福利/中立/反越战/反核/遇刺/奥洛夫
description_zh: 奥洛夫·帕尔梅（1927-1986），瑞典社会民主党领导人，瑞典首相，两次担任首相，推行社会福利政策，支持中立外交，反越战和反核领导者，1986年遇刺死亡，对瑞典社会民主和国际和平产生深远影响。
description_en: Olof Palme (1927-1986), Swedish Social Democratic leader, Swedish Prime Minister, twice served as Prime Minister, implemented social welfare policies, supported neutrality diplomacy, anti-Vietnam War and anti-nuclear leader, assassinated in 1986, profoundly influenced Swedish social democracy and international peace.

reason_en: Palme was Swedish Social Democratic leader, his social welfare policies and neutrality diplomacy profoundly influenced Swedish social democracy and international peace.
